stakeholders.name: Council of Nigerian Mining Engineers and Geoscientists (COMEG)
stakeholders.description: Statutory regulatory council mandated to accredit, certify and regulate the practice of mining engineering and geosciences in Nigeria.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Professional regulation, accreditation and competency assurance.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Accredits academic programmes; licenses professionals; enforces competency and ethical standards; regulates geoscience and mining engineering practice.
stakeholders.mandate: Statutory regulatory council mandated to accredit, certify and regulate the practice of mining engineering and geosciences in Nigeria.

stakeholders.name: The Nigerian Institution of Metallurgical, Mining & Materials Engineers (NIMMME)
stakeholders.description: Professional body promoting metallurgy, mining and materials engineering excellence.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Professional development, engineering standards and capacity building.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Organises conferences; supports engineering innovation; sets technical standards; strengthens collaboration among materials, mining and metallurgy professionals.
stakeholders.mandate: Professional body promoting metallurgy, mining and materials engineering excellence.

stakeholders.name: National Steel Raw Materials Exploration Agency (NSRMEA), Kaduna
stakeholders.description: Federal agency mandated to explore, evaluate and develop steel raw materials including iron ore, limestone and kaolin.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Exploration, resource evaluation and mineral mapping.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Conducts geological mapping; evaluates mineral occurrences; supports steel and industrial minerals development; provides mineral data to industry and government.
stakeholders.mandate: Federal agency mandated to explore, evaluate and develop steel raw materials including iron ore, limestone and kaolin.

stakeholders.name: National Metallurgical Development Centre (NMDC), Jos
stakeholders.description: National R&D centre supporting Nigeria’s metallurgical, minerals processing and materials science sector.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Mineral beneficiation, metallurgical research, pilot-scale mineral processing.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Runs labs and pilot plants; conducts mineral processing studies; supports steel and alloy R&D; provides technical services and professional training.
stakeholders.mandate: National R&D centre supporting Nigeria’s metallurgical, minerals processing and materials science sector.

stakeholders.name: Metallurgical Training Institute (MTI), Onitsha
stakeholders.description: Technical vocational institute offering certified training in metallurgy, welding, industrial maintenance and mineral-related trades.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Technical manpower development and vocational training.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Trains technicians for mining and metallurgy; offers accredited diplomas; provides workshops and industrial attachments; builds skilled workforce for mineral value chain.
stakeholders.mandate: Technical vocational institute offering certified training in metallurgy, welding, industrial maintenance and mineral-related trades.

stakeholders.name: Geological Society of Nigeria (GSN)
stakeholders.description: Professional society advancing geology education, research and responsible georesource development.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Geoscience knowledge development, research and training.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Organises conferences; publishes geological research; supports field training; promotes responsible geoscience and mineral development.
stakeholders.mandate: Professional society advancing geology education, research and responsible georesource development.

stakeholders.name: Nigerian Economic Summit Group (NESG)
stakeholders.description: Private-sector think tank influencing national economic and mineral-sector policy.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Policy advocacy, investment climate reform and economic strategy.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Conducts research; engages government on mining sector reforms; convenes national dialogues; promotes private-sector competitiveness.
stakeholders.mandate: Private-sector think tank influencing national economic and mineral-sector policy.

stakeholders.name: Nigerian Institute of Mining and Geosciences (NIMG)
stakeholders.description: Federal postgraduate institution training professionals in mining engineering, geosciences and mineral management.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Applied research, specialised training and capacity building.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Provides postgraduate training; conducts applied research; strengthens Nigeria’s mining technical capacity; supports mineral development policy.
stakeholders.mandate: Federal postgraduate institution training professionals in mining engineering, geosciences and mineral management.
